accessibility_responsive_review.validation_method: Independent headless-browser validation with Playwright using system Chromium against exact Git-blob-verified approved HTML copies.
scope: no horizontal document overflow at 390x844 mobile viewport
no horizontal document overflow at 1440x900 desktop viewport
accessibility_responsive_review.note: Focused release-gate review only; this is not a claim of full WCAG conformance certification.

design.home_rule: Apply the same reciprocal mk/en/fr/x-default cluster to all three Home language variants only in the dedicated activation PR.
design.institute_rule: Do not add a misleading mk/en/fr Institute hreflang cluster while Macedonian and English share the single runtime URL /institute.html. French Institute remains self-canonical until a future architecture provides distinct stable MK/EN Institute URLs.

hreflang_design_review.reason: The design preserves reciprocal language relationships where stable distinct Home URLs exist and avoids claiming distinct Institute alternates that do not yet exist.

route_fallback_smoke_test.validation_method: GitHub Actions branch-local HTTP smoke test
route_fallback_smoke_test.note: The overall historical workflow run failed later in its browser-marker parsing step; provenance, local server startup and route/fallback smoke steps completed successfully before that harness-only failure.

workflow_harness_note.detail: A later diagnostic workflow edit introduced a YAML registration defect. Attempting to repair the GitHub Actions workflow through the connected write tool was blocked by the platform safety layer. Technical gate evidence therefore uses the successful GitHub route-smoke step plus independent exact-blob browser validation; no public activation is authorized by this workaround.

activation_rule: This evidence file cannot activate French. Technical PASS only permits preparation of a later dedicated French activation PR.
